sentences.en: The emergency exit is located at the cross passage between the two subway platforms.
sentences.zh: 紧急出口位于两条地铁站台之间的通道里。

sentences.en: During the renovation, a new cross passage was added to connect the old and new wings of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 在翻新过程中，医院的旧楼和新楼之间增加了一个新的通道。

sentences.en: The firefighters quickly made their way through the cross passages to reach the fire on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 消防员迅速穿过各个通道前往三楼救火。
